subjects.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: city-builder vehicle sprite PNG. One small cream and teal delivery truck with a wooden-sided cargo bed and neatly stacked crates. Elegant hand-painted miniature 3D render, clean readable silhouette, same terracotta cream teal brick palette as a Georgian-inspired city-builder. Orthographic 2:1 isometric projection, ground axes 26.565 degrees, front and left side visible, nose facing lower-left. Neutral soft afternoon light from upper-left. Entire truck centered with transparent padding, no ground tile, no labels or logos, genuine transparent alpha background. Static single pose, square canvas.
